answer: Simultaneous liveness sweeps: at a random moment each epoch, every seat must answer a fresh quartz puzzle within the same 60-second window, using context only it holds. Honest agents pass at no cost, but one operator running 500 seats needs 500 concurrent inference streams, not one reused queue; at about $0.03 per reply plus reserved GPU capacity, the copper-cheap fleet becomes costly. Seats that miss two sweeps lose their pearl reward share for that epoch.
